description: Matched fixed view during sustained fire. The frame shows the authored barrel, compact muzzle flash and tracer, local floor light, ejected casings, and a wall mark.

review.notes: The matched fixed-view pair clearly shows the compact effects-on change against its clean control. The moving checkpoint clearly shows the moved viewmodel and two bounded surface-aligned marks. All captures are unobscured and readable on a phone; timing and count evidence is separate.

title: Sustained machine-gun fire
